Both scripts replay from the supplied paths.

value.rationale: Identifies the unique natural smallest symmetric-simple-graph bidirected multipath complex bearing torsion, with a complete RP2 summand homotopy classification; sharpness among all 52 unlabeled graphs at order at most five is stronger than an isolated numerical example. It gives a reproducible small non-wedge space relevant to the founding realization question and shows the effect of adding the central edge to symmetric K2,3. No claim of first torsion among unrestricted digraphs.
